info.title: TCC Tabulation System API
info.description: REST API for TCC Tabulation System - Real-time Pageant/Event Scoring Application with WebSocket support via Laravel Reverb

servers.description: LAN Access Server (replace with your IP)

post.description: Reorder rounds in the event sequence

get.description: Returns the current voting state including active session, active round, and lock status

post.description: Starts a new voting session and marks event as active. If event is completed, it will be reactivated.

400.description: Voting is already active or event is archived

post.summary: Stop voting session and mark event as completed
post.description: Stops the active voting session, marks event as completed, and documents the session

post.summary: Activate a specific round for judging
post.description: Sets the active round for judges to score. Must have an active voting session.
Locks all judge screens preventing them from viewing or submitting scores
Unlocks all judge screens allowing them to view and submit scores
Automatically activates the first round from event sequence

get.description: Returns all past voting sessions for an event

get.summary: Get list of occupied judge slots
get.description: Returns array of judge IDs that are currently occupied

post.description: Marks a judge ID as occupied to prevent duplicate logins
Clears all occupied judge slots (admin function)

post.summary: Clear all scores and event sequence
post.description: Clears all scores and event sequence for an event (keeps candidates and judges)

message.example: All scores and event sequence cleared

get.description: Returns current assignment for a device or null if not registered

post.summary: Swap judge assignments between two screens
post.description: Swaps the judge assignments between two registered screens. Scores remain tied to judge_id.

message.example: Judge assignments swapped between Screen 1 and Screen 2

post.description: Broadcasts to judge screens to display their assigned number. Can target all judges or specific ones.

judge_ids.description: Specific judge IDs to show (empty for all)

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds to show the number (default 5000)
